advisory.finding: `_move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs` wraps only `anthropic_client.beta.messages.create`; if the pydantic-ai Anthropic path issues the request via the non-beta `messages.create` (or a future SDK renames the accessor), the wrapper attaches to a method that is never called and silently never fires — the unsupported sampling kwargs would then reach the real create() unmoved, with no error distinguishing 'wrapped and clean' from 'wrapper never ran'.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Harden the httpx2 SDK-contract detection against annotation-format drift (or centralize the string-match in one helper the tests import).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:112-116: selects httpx2 only if `"httpx2.AsyncClient" in str(http_client.annotation)`, else returns stdlib httpx
the same brittle string-match is duplicated across five test helpers (e.g. tests/unit/test_transport_retry.py:35-38)
advisory.finding: The SDK contract detector relies on a substring match of the http_client parameter annotation text ("httpx2.AsyncClient" in str(annotation)); if a future SDK annotates the parameter differently (e.g. a qualified/aliased name, Union, or forward-ref that stringifies without that exact substring) the detector silently selects stdlib httpx and construction then fails with the original TypeError.

Named violating inputs with no covering test: (a) a create() call with extra_body={"x": 1} plus temperature=0.5 (must merge, not clobber); (b) a create() call whose temperature is an anthropic Omit sentinel (must NOT be moved into extra_body).
Only test: tests/unit/test_transport_retry.py:274 drives temperature=0.0 with no pre-existing extra_body and no Omit value.
advisory.finding: Newly added branches of _move_unsupported_beta_create_kwargs are untested: the pre-existing-extra_body MERGE path and the _is_anthropic_omit sentinel guard. The only test passes temperature with no pre-existing extra_body and a plain float, so a regression that clobbered a caller-supplied extra_body or that failed to skip an anthropic Omit sentinel would not be caught.
scenarios: A caller already supplies extra_body while also passing a removed sampling kwarg
A sampling kwarg arrives as anthropic's Omit sentinel rather than a concrete value

The importorskip runs for every model, so a missing httpx2 skips the bedrock parity assertions too.
advisory.finding: In test_provider_parity `_capture`, `anthropic_http = _anthropic_transport_http_module()` (which calls `pytest.importorskip("httpx2")` when the installed anthropic SDK expects httpx2) runs UNCONDITIONALLY, before the `if bedrock:` branch. For bedrock models — which never touch the anthropic http client — this makes the parity test skip whenever the SDK expects httpx2 but httpx2 is not importable, silently dropping bedrock parity coverage that has nothing to do with httpx2.
advisory.suggested_fix: Compute `anthropic_http` only in the non-bedrock branch (right before the `monkeypatch.setattr(anthropic_http, "AsyncHTTPTransport", ...)` call).

dropped.finding: The httpx2 retry transport is discriminated by the private class NAME literal '_Httpx2AsyncTenacityTransport' in _retrying_clients and in a direct assertion, coupling the tests to an internal implementation name; a behavior-preserving rename of that locally-defined class breaks the tests, and when pydantic-ai's own HTTPX2TenacityTransport IS installed the production seam returns that differently-named class so the name check silently excludes the seam's own client (miscounting the negative/positive controls).
